name: tokenized-deposit-demo
description: Midnight (Preview) tokenized deposit demo with Lace wallet

scripts.copy-keys: mkdir -p public && rm -rf public/keys public/zkir && cp -r contract/managed/tdeposit/keys public/keys && cp -r contract/managed/tdeposit/zkir public/zkir && rm -rf public/compiler && cp -r contract/managed/tdeposit/compiler public/compiler
scripts.build: npm run copy-keys && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:single: tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.single.config.ts --mode single && mv dist-single/index.html dist-single/tdeposit-demo.html
scripts.build:pactora: npm run copy-keys && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.pactora.config.ts && mv dist-pactora/pactora.html dist-pactora/pactora-tdeposit-demo.html
